uncited: *   **Inputs:** A trained NeRF model with two MLPs: a coarse network $\Theta_{\text{coarse}}$ and a fine network $\Theta_{\text{fine}}$.
The coarse network outputs predicted density $\sigma$ and radiance.
Identify the set of rays $P$ where $v_\ell < \tau$.
*   **Real-world scenes:** The method relies on transparent backgrounds found in synthetic scenes (e.g., Blender dataset).
*   **Time Complexity:** Reduces the number of fine-pass evaluations.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing intermediate activations $A^{(\ell)}$ for all rays during the coarse pass to compute the threshold.
*   **Quality Trade-offs:** Slight drop in rendering quality.
